verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege credentials for agents are a fair question for an operating system, since an OS manages permissions and credential stores. However, nothing in the evidence shows macOS issuing scoped API credentials to an agent. The Passwords app and general security tools are adjacent features that manage user passwords, not agent-scoped credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
